outcome_access_statement: The auditor did not inspect predictor centers, candidate ranks, center-to-native results, method recovery rates, or baseline recovery rates when recommending or accepting the geometry guard amendment. Only pinned receptor source coordinates and residue identities were used.
adoption_provenance: Coordinating agent accepted the independent uniform 0.1 A maximum-CA recommendation before any site endpoint scoring; the coordinator records the authoritative amendment and run receipt separately.

source_only_decision.rationale: A 0.1 A maximum source-coordinate mismatch is 2.5% of the frozen 4 A candidate-class merging distance, and one tenth of the 1 A endpoint sensitivity spacing. This is a source-geometry guard, not an algorithm accuracy threshold. Every operator must also preserve all CA residue identities, map the whole receptor bijectively, and produce a bijective whole-chain map. The 60 chain permutations close with the icosahedral order pattern.
source_only_decision.implementation_note: The current capsid_symmetry tolerance parameter also guards the initial chain-fit CA RMSD. Actual initial fits are below 0.000527 A in both sources, safely below either guard; authoritative runtime receipt must state whether its chain-fit guard remains 0.05 A or shares the 0.1 A parameter.

method.source_models: Existing expanded 60-subunit deposited receptor models, no additional expansion.
method.operator_construction: Source-chain-to-each-chain proper CA fit proposes a whole-capsid nearest-CA correspondence; every matched residue identity and bijectivity are verified. A proper rigid fit of all corresponding capsid CAs refines the operator. The same maximum-CA guard is then checked on the entire receptor.
method.refit_atoms: All 31080 canonical-protein C-alpha atoms for each source, identical named residue identities across 60 chains. No native ligand atoms, native sites, pocket predictions or mutagenesis residues enter the fit.
method.source_only_additional_checks: The induced whole-chain permutations are bijective and closed, with identity and icosahedral permutation orders. Named canonical heavy atoms are independently compared under those chain mappings as a diagnostic, not an alternate fit.
method.interpretation: Pairwise whole-subunit CA RMSDs near coordinate precision show no meaningful local fold divergence among subunits within either deposited state. Residual whole-capsid mismatch reflects the approximate placement/operator consistency of the expanded source model. This is distinct from real apo-versus-holo conformational change; that comparison is not used to derive the guard.

posthoc_native_orbit_diagnostic.definition: Transform representative holo GAL into the apo receptor frame using only the common-CA receptor fit; apply each frozen apo source operator; transform back to holo; compare corresponding GAL atom names against the 60 deposited holo copies. This is a source-reproduction diagnostic, not predictor accuracy or atomic pose certification.

source_only_decision_hash_scope: Canonical JSON with sorted keys and separators comma/colon of source_only_decision, method, source_audits; excludes all native-orbit diagnostic data.
